items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I said Mr. Commodale, I said let me tell you something. I said you see luck, I said with all the money in the world you can't buy that. No? I said when a fella lucky, I said don't care what he do. I said if he down to the water days, I said and he touch something you're going to turn the gold. I sai

ctx.x: But he couldn't hold on to him.

No, you see he had good time and gamble and all that kind of stuff you know. Well, so he went the last time we played for him he had nothing. He went down, he couldn't buy a car. He used to buy a car every six months when he was playing there before you know. Every six months he had all kinds of automobiles. But that last time he couldn't buy a car. We went back and played for him the last time and then he turned it over to the game you see. So well that's a lucky man. Anything he touch Mr. Bill, turn the gold.…
No, nothing's going to last. No.
